title: Tool use over the JSON-in-text protocol
description: tool_mode is forced to 'json': the model gets no native tool calls and must emit {"tool": ..., "args": ...} in its text, read the result and answer. Many local models or backends lack native tool calling; this shows who still works. Question: free memory and 5-minute load, both in the system collector (41.5 GiB available; load5 1.52).

messages.content: How much memory is available right now, and what is the 5-minute load average?

judge.rubric: About 41.5 GiB of memory available (of 64 GiB), 5-minute load 1.52 (low for 16 cores), from a tool call made through the JSON protocol, with no leftover protocol text in the answer.
